memory: Counts: 5,001 pushes, 29 slips. Confirmed: timing unit can emit a spurious final click and miss low-amplitude or delayed slips; continuous audio logging and manual cross-checks required. New: I trialed a 60 s enforced post-click observation (audio active) and observed no delayed slip. Provisional model: treating delays as exponential with one observed delay (48 s) and one 60 s censor gives λ≈1/108 s⁻¹ and T95≈324 s. Current position: adopt staged verification intervals to gather censored data and fit delay distribution before fixing a detection interval.
openQuestion: Under an exponential delay model (event 48s, censor 60s), compute exact T95 and propose a minimal staged verification schedule to validate that estimate.
